items.s: U.S. futures were mixed early Friday after the Nasdaq's 2.6% drop, its worst day since June, while Western Digital beat estimates with $4.38 billion in revenue yet slid over 6% after hours and Brent hovered near $114.
items.t: AI-fueled tech selloff in focus; Western Digital reports - what's moving markets

items.s: Brent rose another 0.9% to about $114.73 a barrel on Friday after a 4% jump Thursday, with Gulf-to-Asia crude shipping now over five times pre-war costs and the U.S. 10-year yield back below 5%.
items.t: Oil tops $114 as European shares fall and Kering tumbles

items.s: Memory-chip stocks bounced 3% to 6% premarket after Thursday's 6.7% chip-index plunge, helped by Nvidia's Jensen Huang saying he sees no memory surplus before 2029 and SK Hynix shelving a U.S. listing of Solidigm.
items.t: Why Are Micron, SanDisk, and SK Hynix Stocks Surging in Premarket Today After Thursday's Sell-Off?

items.s: U.S. index futures were roughly flat early Friday after Thursday's tech rout, with Brent near $114 and WTI above $100 as Iran signaled it won't negotiate until the U.S. blockade is lifted; flash PMIs, final Michigan sentiment and American Express earnings are due.
items.t: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?

items.s: Brent climbed about 1.2% to roughly $114.50 a barrel and WTI to about $100.80 in Asian trading Friday, extending a rally that took Brent Thursday to its highest settle since early May amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.
items.t: Oil prices rise more than 1% as supply concerns linger

items.s: Global markets were mixed Friday after a Nasdaq drop of 2.6% led by Nvidia (-4.4%), Meta (-7%) and CoreWeave (-10%), while the 10-year Treasury yield fell to about 4.97% from 5.13% and European indexes opened lower.
items.t: World shares are mixed after Wall Street's AI-related losses, while oil prices jump

items.s: The Hoka and Ugg owner earned $2.31 a share on $1.48 billion in revenue, up 3.5% but about $30 million shy of forecasts, and trimmed its full-year sales outlook to $5.7-$5.725 billion versus $5.88 billion expected, sending shares down about 8.5% after hours.
items.t: Deckers Outdoor (DECK) Reports Q2 Earnings Beat but Lowers Sales Outlook, Shares Drop 8.5%

items.s: The casino operator posted Q3 revenue of $990.5 million, slightly below last year's $1.0 billion, with adjusted EBITDAR of $319.6 million and adjusted EPS of $1.67 versus $1.72 a year ago.
items.t: Boyd Gaming Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results

items.s: The Nasdaq closed down 2.6% at 26,008.86, its worst day since early June, and the S&P 500 fell 1.2% while the Dow ended flat, as chip stocks sank 6.7% on AI-spending doubts after Meta fell 7% and Houthi strikes pushed oil to a five-month high.
items.t: S&P 500, Nasdaq end sharply lower as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff

items.s: The three big U.S. carriers slid 4% to 5% after hours on a Bloomberg report that SpaceX is negotiating access to at least 80,000 cell sites for a possible nationwide wireless network, weeks after agreeing to buy 800 MHz spectrum for about $8 billion.
items.t: T-Mobile, Verizon, and AT&T Stocks Are Falling After Hours — What Spooked Investors and What Wall Street Sees Next

items.s: Western Digital's revenue jumped 55% to $4.38 billion on AI-driven storage demand, with adjusted EPS of $4.64, and it guided next quarter to about $5.1 billion in sales.
items.t: WD Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results

items.s: Fuel-cell maker Bloom Energy, a power supplier to data centers, more than doubled quarterly revenue to $1.24 billion (up 138%) and lifted its 2026 sales outlook to $4.4–$4.6 billion.
items.t: Bloom Energy Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance

items.s: The Nasdaq closed down 2.6% at 26,008 and the S&P 500 fell 1.2% while the Dow ended flat, as Meta dropped 7% on its $135B-$145B capex outlook, Tesla slid 3.1%, P&G jumped 5.6%, and WTI crude rose 3% to about $100.
items.t: Nasdaq Sinks 694 Points as Meta Stock Slumps After Earnings: Stock Market Today

items.s: Elon Musk has reportedly put roughly $1 billion into Skydance, the media company formed by Paramount Skydance's $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery, as part of a wider equity raise.
items.t: Elon Musk invests about $1B in Skydance, CNBC reports

items.s: eBay is cutting roughly 1,000 roles, about 9% of staff, per a CEO memo first reported by Reuters, following about 800 cuts in February; shares rose around 1% ahead of its Oct. 28 earnings.
items.t: EBay Slashes 1,000 Jobs In Second Major Round Of Layoffs This Year

items.s: EQT, backed by Abu Dhabi and Canadian pension co-investors, offered $52.22 a share in cash for diagnostics maker Qiagen, a 40% premium valuing it at about $12.1 billion including debt, with closing expected in mid-2027.
items.t: Qiagen set for private ownership as EQT proposes $10.8bn takeover deal

items.s: Qualcomm agreed to buy robotics software firm PickNik, maker of the open-source MoveIt framework, for undisclosed terms while also announcing global layoffs starting in November as it chases a $40 billion non-handset revenue target.
items.t: Qualcomm + PickNik + Layoffs = The Robotics Segment’s Stakes Are Starting To Feel A Bit More Real

items.s: Lam Research beat on record quarterly revenue of $8.22 billion, but softer December-quarter guidance and supply-chain caveats sent the chip-equipment stock down about 11% and prompted Needham, Mizuho and Morgan Stanley to trim price targets.
items.t: Lam Research Analysts Cut Their Forecasts Following Q1 Earnings

items.s: Twenty-six AI and chip names accounted for roughly $1 trillion of the Nasdaq-100's midday losses, with chipmakers shedding about $653 billion and Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet about $367 billion, leaving the Composite 5.4% off its Oct. 6 record.
items.t: Stock Market Today: AI and Chip Stocks Made Up 93% of the Value the Nasdaq-100 Lost

items.s: P&G earned $2.00 a share adjusted on $23.3 billion in sales, up 4%, beating forecasts, reaffirmed its full-year EPS outlook and nudged sales guidance to 2-4%, sending shares up nearly 6%.
items.t: Tide And Gillette Maker Procter & Gamble's Sales Machine Keeps Humming Despite Inflation Pressure

items.s: Union Pacific posted third-quarter revenue of $7.2 billion, up 15% on 6% volume growth, and adjusted EPS of $3.53 that topped forecasts, yet shares slipped about 3% after the report.
items.t: Union Pacific's (NYSE:UNP) Q3 2026 sales beat estimates

items.s: Spotify reported Q3 revenue of about EUR 5.0 billion, up 16%, with 306 million paying subscribers and EUR 672 million in operating income, and guided to EUR 5.2 billion in Q4 revenue.
items.t: Spotify Q3 2026 Update

items.s: A roughly $3.5 trillion SpaceX-Tesla combination would need approval from a majority of all outstanding Tesla shares, where Musk holds only about 20% of votes versus roughly 85% at SpaceX, so the size of any premium may decide the deal.
items.t: The biggest hurdle to a SpaceX merger with Tesla isn't Elon Musk. It's Tesla's shareholders

items.s: Comcast earned an adjusted $1.07 a share on $29.3 billion in revenue, topping forecasts, though it lost 144,000 broadband subscribers; shares rose about 1.5% premarket.
items.t: Earnings call transcript: Comcast beats Q3 2026 profit forecast, shares edge higher

items.s: Chemical maker Dow posted operating earnings of 71 cents a share versus a year-earlier loss, with sales up 13% and net income rising to $525 million as price increases and cost cuts outran higher raw-material and logistics costs.
items.t: Dow beat earnings expectations as profit jumped on higher prices, cost cuts

items.s: U.S. stocks slid Thursday with the Nasdaq down more than 2% as Meta fell about 8% on AI-spending worries, chip stocks sank and Brent crude topped $111 on Middle East tensions.
items.t: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq tumble as tech stocks sink, Meta plummets 8%

items.s: Nasdaq's quarterly net revenue rose 13% to about $1.5 billion with non-GAAP EPS of $1.04, and annual recurring revenue hit a record $3.4 billion as more than 850 clients use its agentic AI fraud and anti-money-laundering tools.
items.t: Nasdaq Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Strong Execution Drives $1.2 Billion of Solutions Revenue & Record ARR of $3.4 Billion

items.s: Lockheed beat estimates with $7.97 a share on revenue up 11% to $20.7 billion and outlined a framework for a decade-long, 850-jet F-35 production deal pending congressional approval.
items.t: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Shares Rise 2.4% Premarket After Q3 Earnings Beat

items.s: S&P 500 futures slid about 1% and Nasdaq futures nearly 1.8% as Brent hit $112 on new Gulf drone strikes, the KOSPI dropped 3.5%, and Tesla fell after trimming its 2026 capex plan from $25 billion to $20 billion.
items.t: Markets sell off worldwide as further conflict looms in the Middle East and Elon Musk cuts capex guidance

items.s: First-time unemployment filings dipped to 194,000 in the week ended Oct. 17, beating the 200,000 forecast, though continuing claims ticked up.
items.t: US Initial Jobless Claims Fall to Three-Month Low of 194,000

items.s: American now expects a 2026 adjusted loss of $1.00 to $1.60 a share after a $269 million third-quarter loss, even as revenue rose 19% to $16.3 billion on higher fares; shares fell 3.5% premarket.
items.t: American Airlines forecasts 2026 loss as fuel costs outpace fare gains

items.s: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek reportedly pulled in about 100 billion yuan from more than 15 backers, double its initial target, at a roughly $74 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a possible 2027 STAR Market IPO.
items.t: DeepSeek raises $15 billion at $74 billion valuation, backed by Tencent, CATL, and Chinese tech giants

items.s: Taiwan's Fair Trade Commission rejected Grab's $600 million purchase of Foodpanda's local business over its ties to Uber, which owns 13.1% of Grab and runs rival Uber Eats.
items.t: Taiwan blocks Grab's $600 million Foodpanda deal, citing Uber's 13.1% stake in the Southeast Asian super app

items.s: New York is putting $10 million in public money into a Queens AI Jobs Institute run by Pursuit that aims to train up to 40,000 residents by 2032, as the metro's tech workforce reached 394,300 and passed the Bay Area.
items.t: No city employs more tech workers than New York. Now it's spending $10 million to train 40,000 people for AI jobs

items.s: Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 1.7% early Thursday as Tesla (-5%), IBM (-5.7%) and Lam Research (-8.4%) slid despite earnings beats, while Lockheed rose about 2.5% on a record $292 billion backlog and raised 2026 sales guidance.
items.t: Premarket movers: Tesla, IBM slide; Meta earnings fail to lift sentiment

items.s: Blackstone's third-quarter distributable earnings slipped to $1.32 a share from $1.52 a year earlier as asset sales slowed, though assets under management rose 10% to $1.37 trillion on $63 billion of inflows.
items.t: Blackstone's Profit Falls as Choppy Market Tempers Investment Exits

items.s: Thursday's session turned lower, led by the Nasdaq, as investors balked at Big Tech AI capex plans after Meta and Tesla results while oil prices climbed on Middle East risk.
items.t: Nasdaq tumbles on AI spending concerns and jump in oil prices: Live updates

items.s: Meta will issue a one-for-one dividend of non-voting Class C shares, effective January 2027, letting Zuckerberg sell stock to cover a possible California wealth tax without dropping far below his roughly 61% voting control.
items.t: Zuckerberg told Meta directors he might leave California, where he could lose billions to a wealth tax. Meta answered with a new class of stock

items.s: Southwest cut its full-year adjusted EPS outlook to $2.60–$2.85 from about $4 despite record revenue, and expects to pay up to $4.55 a gallon for jet fuel in Q4.
items.t: Southwest Airlines Slashes 2026 Profit Guidance on Higher Fuel Bills

items.s: OpenAI is taking ChatGPT advertising to 26 more countries, 89 markets in total, after its ad business hit a $1 billion annualized run rate and drew more than 100,000 advertisers.
items.t: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 26 more countries

items.s: Trump urged data center developers to pay host communities a direct 'dividend' to overcome growing local resistance to AI infrastructure projects.
items.t: 'MAKE DEALS': Trump says data centers should pay communities a 'dividend' to win support

items.s: Abu Dhabi satellite firm Space42 has committed about $1.7 billion to new projects, including a $600 million stake in a direct-to-device venture with Viasat, aiming to double revenue to $600 million by 2030.
items.t: Beyond the UAE: Space42's $1.7 billion bid to go global

items.s: U.S. stocks finished up, with the Nasdaq gaining 1.1%, the S&P 500 0.6% and the Dow 0.7%, as SpaceX rose 7.8% on a quarterly beat and Tesla added 3.4% ahead of its results.
items.t: Wall Street closes higher; SpaceX, Tesla push markets up

items.s: IBM earned $2.95 a share on $17.1 billion in third-quarter revenue, topping forecasts as software sales grew 8% to $7.8 billion, and it raised its free-cash-flow outlook, sending shares up more than 4% after hours.
items.t: IBM shares climb on earnings beat

items.s: Stocks closed higher Wednesday, with the Nasdaq up 1.05%, the S&P 500 up 0.58% to 7,757 and the Dow up 0.69%, as SpaceX jumped 7.8% on AI-driven results and chip stocks led gains.
items.t: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rise as tech rallies, SpaceX stock surges nearly 8%

items.s: Tesla posted $28.05 billion in Q3 revenue and $0.48 adjusted EPS, edging past estimates, though operating income fell 56% to about $718 million as auto and energy sales slipped.
items.t: Tesla beats on earnings and sales even as auto revenue declines

items.s: Meta beat with $64.6 billion in Q3 revenue, but a $10 billion youth-safety settlement and $34.9 billion of quarterly capex cut operating margin to 20% and pushed free cash flow to negative $2.1 billion; 2026 capex guidance is now $135–145 billion.
items.t: Meta’s revenue surges 26% to $64.6 billion, but billions in settlements and skyrocketing AI spending turn screws on profit, free cash flow

items.s: Brent topped $110 in late trading after a drone strike on a Saudi Aramco field killed two people, while WTI settled down 4.6% at $97.15; crude is up roughly 80% this year.
items.t: Oil Gains After Saudi Oil Field Attack

items.s: Netflix shares fell about 4–5% after it guided Q4 revenue to $13.44 billion, under the $13.51 billion consensus, and cut its 2026 ad revenue outlook to $2.7 billion from $3 billion, though analysts urged buying the dip.
items.t: Netflix is sliding after earnings. Analysts say buy the dip

items.s: AT&T beat estimates and raised its 2026 profit outlook, yet its stock fell 6.5% to $21.91 as postpaid phone adds of 379,000 missed forecasts and investors weighed competition from SpaceX's Starlink Mobile.
items.t: Stock Market Today, Oct. 21: AT&T Beats Earnings on Strong Fiber Growth, Raises 2026 Profit Outlook

items.s: Supermicro raised its September-quarter sales outlook by about $4 billion to $18.5–19.5 billion and lifted gross margin guidance to 12–12.5%, sending shares up roughly 12% with Dell and HPE also higher.

items.s: Brent rose 1.3% to about $110 a barrel and U.S. crude to $99.40 on Gulf shipping risks; GasBuddy estimates Americans have spent $138.8 billion extra on fuel since March 1.
items.t: Oil prices jump on elevated risk in Strait of Hormuz

items.s: SpaceX shares rose about 9% after revenue jumped 161% to $14.6 billion, well above estimates, while Netflix slid nearly 7% and the 10-year Treasury yield held near 5.09%.

items.s: Drug distributor Cencora agreed to buy American Oncology Network, a 350-plus-provider practice group in 21 states, for up to $2.4 billion including $100 million in contingent payments.

items.s: Southwest reports after Wednesday's close and American before Thursday's open, with Brent above $110 and analysts expecting about 18% revenue growth at both carriers.
